en: A monochrome postcard showing an inner courtyard with Baroque and Renaissance architectural elements. Visible are a domed tower-like structure with arched windows, ornate window frames on the adjacent building, an external staircase with an arched entrance, and a decorative well with an elaborate wrought-iron canopy in the courtyard. The borders are light-colored, and there is printed caption text along the bottom edge.
